findings.criterion: Write every experience bullet as a full qualification: what you did, how you did it, the result, and the context it happened in.
findings.detail: For each bullet, identify all four parts: action, method/tool, outcome/result, and context (where or who it helped). If any bullet misses one of these parts, fail the resume. Recruiters hunt for qualifications, not bare tasks; without the result and context they don't know what you did or why it mattered and you don't get considered.
